parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: DBNodeDescription
parameters.description:
The name of the node. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DBNodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster node.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~185342~~) operation to view the details of all clusters that belong to your account, including node IDs.
